title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00008 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: Stabbed on lubricator and leak tested rig-up to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min using 100 MEG.
01:15 - 02:10: Opened HMV. Equalized and opened DHSV. WHP 59 bar.
02:10 - 04:45: RIH w/ run straddle-resolve-tufftrac MAX od 5. 63" straddle) from surface to hud at 2830 m. Performed PU every 500 m. Depth PUW 500 3000 1000 3650 1500 4650 2000 5250 2500 6550
04:45 - 07:00: Activated tractor and RIH with tractor from 2830 m to 3580 m. Average running speed 9 m/min. WHP 63 bar.
07:00 - 07:35: Continued RIH with tractor activated from 3580 m to 3735 m. Average running speed 8 m/min.
07:35 - 13:00: Performed 8 correlation passes in interval 3730 3640 mmd. Experienced severe stick-slip and difficulties getting on depth with correlation log.
13:00 - 14:30: Made 2 attempt to position BHA at setting depth by logging up from 3720 mmd. Slightly off-depth from correlation log, unable to position straddle within desired uncertainty margin. Positioned BHA on third pass by logging up from 3720 mmd to 3766. 8 mmd.
14:30 - 15:00: Set straddle across interval 3674. 4 3685. 0 mmd. Lost 2000 lbs immediately. Tagged straddle with tractor to verify set. WHP 67 bar.
15:00 - 17:25: POOH from 3765 mmd to surface. Average pulling speed 30 m/min. WHP 69 bar.
17:25 - 18:45: Closed and inflow tested SV and HMV. Purge riser with n2.
18:45 - 19:05: Performed tool-box talk on drillfloor prior to l/d BHA.
19:05 - 19:30: Broke lubricator. L/d BHA on deck.
19:30 - 20:45: Checked cable head and tractor for next run.
20:45 - 20:55: Performed tool-box talk on drillfloor prior to m/u BHA.
20:55 - 21:35: M/u BHA for run straddle-resolve-tufftrac).
21:35 - 22:05: Stabbed on lubricator and tested QTS to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
22:05 - 22:25: Equalized and opened HMV and SV. HW 2280 lbs. WHP 71 bar.
22:25 - 00:00: RIH w/ run straddle-resolve-tufftrac MAX od 5. 63" straddle) from surface to 2050 mmd. Performed PU every 500 m.
